ValidationRule.description: Prevents Account Plans from moving to Ready for Review unless ABC Segment Verification is Verified. Ensures segment change requests are Resolved before RVP review.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED( Status ), ISPICKVAL( Status , "Ready for Review"), NOT( ISPICKVAL( ABC_Segment_Verification__c , "Verified")
) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: ABC Segment Verification must be Verified before the Account Plan can move to Ready for Review. Complete verification or resolve any pending segment change request.
